content.description: KTON LST is a TON staking or liquid staking protocol. Next-generation liquid staking protocol built for the TON ecosystem, designed to unlock liquidity for both retail and institutional users. It gives users staking, yield, or liquid access to TON-based positions. KTON LST belongs in TON DeFi because its main workflow gives users a way to trade, earn, borrow, stake, or manage liquidity through an actual product surface. KTON LST is kept in this TON set because its product has a concrete user or builder workflow, not only a loose mention of the network.
